note: The unicode case past the TRUNCATION boundary, which the short one cannot reach. Receipt labels are cut at 60 RUNES (rowLabel), and this record has both shapes that distinguish an implementation: labels over the limit that must be cut, and one label of 47 runes / 139 bytes that must NOT be — a host limiting bytes would truncate it, and truncating a 3-byte rune at byte 60 emits U+FFFD where the question had a character. Every label must remain valid UTF-8 and end in the ellipsis or not at all. Its own producing run also found a real defect: fakeAnswer truncated the echoed statement by byte (provider/fake.go).
